sections.A: Meniscus ghutne mein do C-shape ke cartilage pad hain jo jhatka jazb karte hain. Tear naujawanon mein mudne ki chot se aur bari umar mein ghisne se hota hai.
sections.B: Ghutne ke andar ya bahar joint line par dard, mudne, gehre squat ya ghutne tekne se. Kabhi sujan, atakna ya lock hona.
sections.C: Chot achanak (mudna) thi ya dheere dheere, dard kahan hai, aur kya ghutna atakta ya lock hota hai.
sections.D: Sujan, muscles, chaal, effusion aur range dekhein, khaas kar poori extension mein rukawat.
sections.E: Koi aik test meniscus tear ka accurate diagnosis nahi karta. Joint line par dard, history aur tests ko milayein.
sections.F: ACL injury (pop, tezi se sujan, Lachman positive) aur MCL sprain isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Locked knee (poori extension mein asli rukawat): urgent refer. Garam laal sooja ghutna: infection ka shak.
sections.H: Asli lock ho to urgent refer. Warna joint line dard, mudne ka dard aur positive tests: meniscal injury; zyada tar exercise se shuru.
sections.I: Quadriceps, hamstring aur pindli par soft tissue kaam, aur chapni ki mobilisation.
sections.J: Ghisne wale aur bohat se stable tears mein exercise pehli line hai: taaqat, balance aur dheere dheere load.
sections.K: Shuru mein thand aur compression; TENS optional.
sections.L: Lock aur doosre ligaments check karein, samjhayein, phir exercise. Asli lock ya behtari na ho to surgeon.
sections.M: Sujan, range (khaas kar extension), joint line dard, atakne ke episodes aur taaqat dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 52 saal ki khatoon ko bagh mein gehra squat karne ke baad ghutne ke andar dard hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: locked knee screen karein, phir education aur exercise.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
